summary: Accept immediately available piped credentials in agent mode while bounding empty-pipe reads.
reason: Rejecting every non-interactive invocation prevented agents and CI from using the documented safe stdin credential channel, while an unbounded read could hang on an inherited open-empty pipe.
validated_outcome: Agent mode accepts a newline-terminated piped key, waits for delayed producers within the configurable request timeout, and obeys context cancellation for an open-empty pipe.
